quests.desc: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, try to head east. With that accomplished, take a trip south. Okay, and then, attempt to travel south. Then, go west. And then, attempt to travel west. Then, head north. Then, move north. And then, assure that the cabinet is opened. And then, take the keycard from the cabinet. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: You are now playing a life changing game of TextWorld! First of all, attempt to travel east. Next, try to head south. After that, make an attempt to move south. After that, make an attempt to go to the west. Okay, and then, move west. And then, attempt to move north. With that accomplished, go north. Then, look and see that the cabinet is wide open. After that, take the keycard from the cabinet within the office. And once you've done that, you win!
